header.title: Switch
header.description: On/off toggle with a sliding thumb animation. Use it for preferences that apply right away. Also exported as `Toggle`.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Tweak the props and see the result and code instantly.
playground.label: Enable notifications

base.title: Base
base.description: A Switch with `label` and `helperText`, off by default.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` locks the control and dims the label and message.

disabledOff.title: Disabled off
disabledOff.description: The same `isDisabled` state with the switch turned off.

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` replaces `helperText`, forces the error tone and is announced with `role="alert"`.

texts.label: Share usage analytics
texts.errorMessage: You must enable this to continue.

required.title: Required
required.description: `isRequired` adds the asterisk to the label and `aria-required` to the input.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: The seven tones of the `tone` prop. The tone colors the track when on.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes with `size`: sm, md and lg. They change the track, thumb and text.

labelStart.title: Label start
labelStart.description: `labelPlacement="start"` puts the label before the track, handy for settings rows.

texts.label: Wi-Fi
texts.helperText: The label sits before the track.

withoutLabel.title: Without label
withoutLabel.description: With no visible text, pass `aria-label` to give it an accessible name.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: With `checked` and `onChange` you manage the state from your component.

withTooltip.title: With tooltip
withTooltip.description: Switch has no info prop: the info button is a separate element. In the first and last cases it sits to the right of the Switch inside a flex container; the Switch takes the remaining width, so the container limits the width to keep the button close to the label. `FieldInfoButton` renders the icon with its Tooltip; for custom content, wrap a `.gem-field-info` button with `Tooltip`. In the second case the Switch is disabled, so the Tooltip wraps a `<span tabIndex={0}>` that receives focus.

texts.priorityInfo: Priority support is available on Pro plans.

header.title: Switch API
header.description: API reference for the Switch React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `Toggle` is an alias of the same component.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, Switch accepts native <input> attributes (InputHTMLAttributes) except size and type. They go to the <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; use wrapperClassName for the container. isDisabled and isRequired take precedence over disabled and required.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: Uses a native <input type="checkbox"> with role="switch", so screen readers announce on or off.
a11y.keyboard: Space toggles the state like any checkbox; Enter toggles it too.
a11y.label: The label wraps the input. With no visible label, pass aria-label.
a11y.describedBy: errorMessage or helperText is linked through aria-describedby; the error uses role="alert".

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on props. Useful for styling with CSS.

rules.label: <label> element wrapping the control and text.
rules.control: Container for the input and the track.
rules.input: Native input (invisible, covers the track). Receives `className`.
rules.track: Switch track. Takes the tone color when on.
rules.thumb: Circle that slides inside the track.
rules.message: Helper or error text below the switch.
rules.messageError: Applied to the message when `errorMessage` is set.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Set on the root container. Redefine them on your `wrapperClassName` to change colors and dimensions without overriding rules.

items.--gem-switch-tone: Background and border of the track when on.
items.--gem-switch-tone-active: Track background on hover while on.
items.--gem-switch-track-h: Track height. The thumb is computed from it.
items.--gem-switch-pad: Space between the thumb and the track edge.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers. `ToggleProps` is an alias of `SwitchProps`.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <input> attributes (except size and type).

items.label: Visible label next to the control.
items.labelPlacement: Label position relative to the track.
items.helperText: Helper text below. Hidden when `errorMessage` is set.
items.errorMessage: Error message below. Implies the invalid state.
items.tone: Tone of the on state. Switches to error with `isInvalid` or `errorMessage`.
items.isDisabled: Disables the switch. Prefer it over native disabled.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (`aria-required` and asterisk).
items.id: Input id. Used to link the label and messages.
items.name: Field name when submitting a form.
items.aria-label: Accessible name when there is no label.
items.className: Extra classes for the native input.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onKeyDown: Fires on key press. Calling preventDefault stops Enter from toggling.
